_comment: Path combos (Docs/plan/DATA_SCHEMAS.md 'Combo', cooks/biome-lightning.md 2.18.4): a main path and subclass pair with at least at25 / at50 points spent in BOTH paths owns that level's combo. grants: the gameplay tags the owner gets (the combat code reads them). requires: 'path.node' the owner must have learned too (CB rule: Meltdown needs Overheat, Blizzard storm needs Blizzard). numbers: the combo's own first-draft numbers (FWRComboRegistry::Num). Loaded by WRCombos.cpp; the pairs with no grants yet are display-only.

at25.name: Thaw
at25.text: Burning a frozen enemy deals a big burst of damage

at50.name: Balance
at50.text: Heat and Chill fill each other as you use them

at25.name: Plasma
at25.text: Fire on shocked enemies arcs as burning lightning

at50.name: Meltdown
at50.text: Overheat explosions chain lightning to every enemy they hit

at25.name: Brittle shock
at25.text: Shocks on frozen enemies shatter them
